preview: Earlier finding | ZVF measures groups whose sampled completions have identical rewards. Two reviewed tool-use cases: reward 0, ZVF 1, GU ...

text:
The research starts with a simple observation: when every answer in a training group receives the same reward, subtracting the group average leaves no reward contrast. The ZVF work studies that condition. This context relates to NeurIPS 2026 submission 36320. The earlier Qwen3-8B study and today’s larger adapted model are separate experiments. No submission outcome or causal capability gain is asserted.

The user's term “Z-index” is presented alongside the manuscript's actual term Zero-Variance Fraction (ZVF). No separate formally named Z-index was established by the inspected sources. ZVF counts homogeneous within-prompt reward groups. GU is the submitted complement, Gradient Utilization, equal to 1 minus ZVF. For the submitted group-standardized runner, equal rewards remove the centered reward-contrast term. This does not imply that reference-KL or auxiliary contributions to a total gradient vanish. The reviewed two synthetic tool-use cases both had online reward zero, ZVF one and GU zero. Held-out performance was not evaluated for those cases. These observations do not establish predictive validity, a stopping policy, or capability gain.

The local July28 rebuttal audit and July30 reviewer9kjk follow-up identify NeurIPS2026 submission36320, forum CXbcYe69BQ, and the title shown. The audit records the exact reviewed17-page PDF hash b15ac7e5f673473cf8edc07634f6acbd9fcd54b9f0d5d1f75b106565a174a62d. This slide relies on those local records. The current public forum could not be retrieved during this check. No acceptance, rejection or successful posting of the locally prepared replies is asserted. Current paper.tex is a local descendant rather than the authenticated reviewed PDF. Later studies do not retroactively change that submission.

The earlier Qwen3-8B/GSM8K evidence and heterogeneous model/stack cases are distinct from today's Qwen3.6-35B-A3B plus final Pavlov adapter, Tinker-trained seed809 and merged BF16. The current actor base is Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B@995ad96eacd98c81ed38be0c5b274b04031597b0; adapter arvindcr4/pavlov-portfolio-qwen36-seed809-stepfinal-tinker-cf0ad8c1-1f1b-5ff-9f777c4018b6@64444133c55d88c3f1bf0df8a2f5d7ac646125c8. The public E1–E14 evaluations use their own task definitions and native evaluators. They are a separate transfer-evaluation program and do not establish a causal effect of ZVF. This addendum introduces no new benchmark score.
